comment: The verdicts of a run of all tests: one process per mutant, --shared-process, and --select-tests reach with --confirm-kills full (with and without --shared-process). The six mutants that index out of range crash the host (stopped at the first crash, confirmed by a second run); the mutants of isExpensive and isCheap survive although their suite fails when it is run by itself (it needs GuardASetupTests); the two mutants of threshold() that only show without the state that GuardASetupTests leaves survive; the loop that does not end is a Timeout (one test that does not end, repeated once under xcodebuild).

Guards.drain(_:)::side-effect-removal: after its first test had started
in a shared process, directly after the same tests had passed
Guards.pickNamed(_:)::boundary: in the Swift Testing test "picks the first entry outside the table"; the run was stopped there
Guards.pickNamed(_:)::ternary-swap: in the Swift Testing test "picks the first entry outside the table"; the run was stopped there

detailsComment: details: the detail of every mutant of the key must contain one of the texts (which limit stopped the run: without a limit inside the run a Crash is 'the test host ended unexpectedly' after every restart, and a Timeout names the limit of the whole run). maxSeconds: the mutant's time; a crash that is waited through, or a hang waited for with the limit of the whole run, takes longer.
